notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
